test_title: PYST 2: SSC JE ME- General Intelligence (Held On 09 Oct 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Peter departs from his home and walks 10 m towards north and then turns right and walks 36 m. He turns left and walks 5 m. Now he turns left again and walks 25 m and stops. A pole is placed exactly 15 m south from where he is standing. How far and in which direction is his house from the pole? (Assuming that all turns are 90 degree turns only.)
solution:
According to the given information,

1) Peter departs from his home and walks 10 m towards north.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d662ed4a89f5f4dea59295335d6e70eece08d5161386b4f44a057c9ef97b04f1.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/afd28ccdfff84df5d3ca6b72438b630e125434e54636327f2f903950d0c5145f.png] 

2) She then turns right and walks 36 m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/042c38cf27a6e98909ec22b83337c77029a7a6649b0b0a581aa41fdb12bfb997.png] 

3) He turns left and walks 5 m. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72b47f3bef20720a36ec5602f3d24d9675eb8a556d67328316404bfecdccc268.png] 

4) Now he turns left again and walks 25 m and stops.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e82e93eb178574db0d390a1076ba423c435c8589d41ac86d84a92e663620b2f.png] 

5) A pole is placed exactly 15 m south from where he is standing.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8474f37929e1205481df099126d69959534b4412f8990116180499af61d4fbba.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"****11 m, west"**.
